source: None. Ron and Friends 2026 is an inaugural redraft season.
note: EMPTY ON PURPOSE. This file held the previous league's post-season roster with each player's prior-season draft round, which is what a keeper's cost round is derived from. Ron and Friends has no prior season on Sleeper, so there are no rounds to derive from and no eligible keepers.
whyTheFileStillExists: The keeper machinery stays on disk and importable so keepers can be switched on in a later season. An empty `players` list is how the data says there is nothing to price.
